exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosed in the third trimester
GDM diagnosed in the second trimester
Timing of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis (second trimester vs. third trimester)
outcome: Caesarean section due to suspected macrosomia
cohort: 500 women diagnosed with GDM (375 diagnosed in the second trimester and 125 diagnosed in the third trimester)
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM in the third trimester had a higher incidence of morbid obesity, macrosomia, and caesarean section due to suspected macrosomia, while women diagnosed in the second trimester had a higher incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Caesarean section due to suspected macrosomia was higher in women diagnosed with GDM in the third trimester compared to those diagnosed in the second trimester.
